Find CPT Codes for Case Logs, and Learn the Coding Behind Them

FreeCPTCodeFinder.com helps medical students, residents, fellows, and early-career clinicians quickly look up CPT codes for clinical case logging while learning the wRVUs, modifiers, global periods, billing basics, and documentation concepts they will use as attendings.

Trust and editorial transparency

Built by a trauma surgeon for real-world case logging and coding education

FreeCPTCodeFinder.com was created by Graydon Stallard, DO, FACOS, FACS, a board-certified general surgeon and surgical critical care surgeon. He built it to help medical students, residents, fellows, APPs, and early-career clinicians find CPT codes faster, understand the coding logic behind them, and verify what they use against official sources.

Educational reference only. Always verify CPT, CMS, payer, and program-specific requirements before submitting claims or logging cases.

Splenic flexure mobilization add-on
Laparoscopic/robotic colectomy workflow: consider 44213. Report only when the operative note documents actual mobilization/take-down of the splenic flexure to obtain bowel length or facilitate a tension-free anastomosis.
Educational suggestion only. This is an add-on procedure and is not appropriate as a standalone CPT line.

Modifier selection
